semiconductor_relevance: High - Adelhelm Kunststoffbeschichtungen GmbH specializes in functional surface coatings specifically designed for the semiconductor industry, addressing critical challenges such as contamination control and chemical protection.
summary: Adelhelm Kunststoffbeschichtungen GmbH provides high-performance coatings for the semiconductor industry, focusing on corrosion and chemical protection, as well as electrically insulating and conductive coatings. Their solutions are essential for ensuring the purity and reliability of gases and chemicals used in semiconductor manufacturing processes.
capabilities: Functional surface coatings for chemical distribution systems
Coatings for duct-work and critical equipment
